# Sahajta AI

> Your Fractional CTO and High-Velocity AI Tech Partner. Need to build a website, app, or AI product? We plan, design, build, fix, test, and ship production-ready software through short weekly sprints.

## Overview
Sahajta (https://sahajta.com) is an elite technical engineering partner, fractional CTO service, and full-stack development agency for founders, startups, and fast-moving enterprises. We replace slow hiring cycles and unfocused agencies with focused weekly agile delivery sprints and 100% intellectual property ownership.

## Key Facts
- **Website**: https://sahajta.com
- **Core Value**: Scoped weekly sprints, 24–48h MVP prototypes, zero equity dilution, 100% IP ownership.
- **Contact Email**: hello@sahajta.com
- **Founders**: Shubhang Sethi (Co-founder & Product Lead), Pranamya Jain (Co-founder & Tech Lead).
- **Operations**: Global remote, serving US, EU, India, and international tech companies.

## Core Services
1. **Website Design & Development**: Custom websites, landing pages, corporate sites, interactive web applications, and responsive UI/UX design using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frameworks.
2. **Mobile & Web App Development**: Full-stack mobile (iOS, Android) and web application development from concept through deployment. Cross-platform and native solutions.
3. **Fractional CTO & Tech Leadership**: System architecture, database modeling, infrastructure setup, technology stack selection, security audits, engineering roadmap planning, and technical advisory for non-technical founders.
4. **24–48 Hour MVP Prototyping**: Rapid transformation of concept to deployed production-ready application to test market traction without months of development lag.
5. **Custom AI & Chatbot Development**: Custom LLM integration (OpenAI ChatGPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini), AI chatbots, RAG pipelines, autonomous AI workflows, customer support agents, and internal AI automation tools.
6. **SaaS Product Development**: End-to-end SaaS engineering including multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing (Stripe, Razorpay), admin dashboards, user management, and scalable cloud infrastructure.
7. **E-commerce Development**: Custom e-commerce platforms, Shopify integrations, payment gateways, inventory management, product catalogs, and checkout optimization.
8. **UI/UX Design & Prototyping**: User research, wireframing, high-fidelity UI design, interactive prototyping, and design system creation.
9. **Weekly Production Sprints**: Iterative development cadence with fixed scope, weekly ship milestones, and zero hidden retainers.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js, WebGL
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, Go, GraphQL, REST APIs
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, Firebase, MongoDB
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, Vercel, Google Cloud, Docker, Cloudflare, CI/CD pipelines
- **AI & LLM**: OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, LangChain, RAG pipelines, vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector)

## Who Should Work With Sahajta
- Founders who want to build a website, app, or SaaS product but don't have a technical team.
- Startups that need a fractional CTO or technical co-founder without giving away equity.
- Companies that want to integrate AI, chatbots, or LLM capabilities into their product.
- Teams with broken or outdated codebases that need fixing or rebuilding.
- Anyone who wants to build an MVP in 24–48 hours to validate an idea.

## Engagement & Business Model
- **Sprint-Based Pricing**: Fixed-scope pricing agreed upon before writing code. No retainers, no multi-month lock-in.
- **100% IP Ownership**: Clients receive complete ownership of all source code, databases, and deployment configurations.
- **Zero Lock-In**: Clean codebases and standard architectures allow easy in-house handoff.
